notes: Confirmed against the golden/kpn_trading set (whole-catalogue capture of KPN_Kangaroo-updated.pdf, 2026-08-13): the full-pipeline golden e2e reproduces the BizOps sheet (golden_samples_by_supplier/k_p_n_trading_limited.csv) on code, price, basis qty and sellable qty for the 3 covered S&C SKUs. Split out of kpn_trading.catalogue_bundle.v1 after a full read of all 44 K.P.N. Trading pages in KPN_Kangaroo.pdf found the bundle's mixed price basis was three distinct, separately resolvable situations. This one covers layouts where exactly one wholesale amount is printed, always per pack/unit/bag, with no competing case-level figure. 2026-08-17: the pack+case frozen-raw layout folded into this contract as the OPTIONAL case_wholesale_price bulk-term column (user ruling: pack+case is the pack layout plus an MBB column) — its FRB-3 example lives here now, and the retired kpn_trading.pack_and_case_bulk_list.v1 fixture is deleted.
